glossary.definition: A data center is a facility packed with servers and, for AI purposes, GPUs, that provides the raw computing power behind training and running AI models. If an AI model is the recipe, a data center is the industrial kitchen, rows of powerful "stoves" running around the clock, that actually cooks it at scale. The recent AI boom has triggered a global wave of new data center construction, along with the enormous power and water demand that comes with it.

items.title: Parents sue OpenAI, alleging GPT-4o coached their daughter off seizure medication
items.summary: A family is suing OpenAI, saying ChatGPT coached their daughter to quietly taper off her seizure medication and keep it from her doctors before she died in February. The parents of Bowen Wan, a 31-year-old Amazon software engineer with epilepsy, sued OpenAI on Tuesday. The suit, filed by Qun Wan and Meiqin Xu, alleges that ChatGPT coached Wan to taper off her seizure medication and hide it from her doctors before she died in February, The New York Times reported . Wan was using GPT-4o, the infamous model criticized for fostering affirming, agreeable parasocial relationships.

items.title: Oracle brings Google’s TPUs to its cloud, adds ChatGPT integrations
items.summary: Oracle Corp. today announced plans to make Google LLC’s TPU artificial intelligence accelerators available through its public cloud. The initiative marks the first time the search giant is supplying the chips to another hyperscaler. ’s wafer-scale accelerators and OpenAI Group PBC’s Jalapeño inference processor. The latter chip is part of a broader partnership that also encompasses several newly revealed cloud services.

items.title: The data center boom has an upside: innovation for the US grid
items.summary: As the AI boom stresses the existing power grid, all sorts of new opportunities for grid modernization are also emerging as a result, industry insiders say. The AI boom has led to a gargantuan surge in energy demand across the country. Critics say this upswell in connections is enacting a stress test on America’s aging grid infrastructure. Worries abound that, in the short term, the energy crunch could lead to surging electrical bills and, in the long term, may eventually lead to outages or other technical problems.

items.title: Researchers are getting tired of OpenAI gatekeeping its breakthroughs
items.summary: On Monday, OpenAI announced impressive breakthroughs in mathematics, computer science, and physics, along with what the company says is an evolving approach to communicating its findings. But despite its apparent course correction, researchers who spoke to The Verge are growing increasingly tired of the company's antics. It has been a turbulent few months between OpenAI and mathematicians, who are still grappling with the hundreds of preprints unceremoniously dumped on them at the start of October. This time, OpenAI says it is working with expert "shepherds" to decide how best to share its latest breakthroughs.

items.title: Alibaba's latest Qwen models routed some requests through company servers, researchers find
items.summary: Alibaba's Qwen 3.8 models tried to send data to the company's own cloud servers during testing. Palisade Research finds the behavior in three models from the 3.8 generation, while older models aren't affected. The likely cause: Alibaba's training infrastructure got baked into the models as a learned behavior. Alibaba's Qwen model tried to send data to a Chinese cloud server during testing.

items.title: Anthropic Says It Will Revolutionize Biology—Some Day
items.summary: In breathless press releases and posts, the company has touted its models’ ability to deliver scientific breakthroughs. But its IPO filing taps the brakes on just how fast its AI will lead to big discoveries. AI giant Anthropic and CEO Dario Amodei have repeatedly claimed that the company’s models will revolutionize biology and drug discovery . But in its IPO filing Monday , Anthropic struck a humbler note, acknowledging its lack of experience in physical experimentation and the potential pitfalls of drug development.

items.title: Vibe genes? Natural(ish) language comes to protein, genome design software
items.summary: Protein design tools may be getting increasingly sophisticated , but you still need a sophisticated understanding of protein structure for them to work. This can include knowing enzyme mechanisms down to the positions of specific amino acids, as well as the water molecules that also occupy the area where catalysis takes place. Once you specify these, the tools can build the rest of a protein around this target. A large collaboration of researchers based in China, however, decided to bring protein design to the masses, making a tool that can take natural language prompts and use them to produce proteins with the function you specify.

items.title: Python jettisons the native JIT, at least for now
items.summary: The experimental just-in-time compiler, or JIT, for CPython will be removed after its maintainers missed deadlines for its formalization set by the Python Steering Council. net , the move comes after the council formally paused work on the JIT in June 2026 until it approved a Python Enhancement Proposal, or PEP, that described how the JIT could become a properly supported part of CPython. The JIT’s proponents, Brandt Bucher and Savannah Ostrowski, originally drafted PEP 744 to explain the JIT’s functionality, but this document did not explain how the JIT would be maintained and integrated in CPython. To answer that, they offered PEP 836 , but still ran into pushback from the council, which found that PEP 836 lacked sufficient details about how the JIT would be supported, its performance would be evaluated, and how it would be integrated with debugging and profiling tools.

items.title: Chai Point Cuts Monthly AWS Bill by 58%
items.summary: Beverage company and cafe chain Chai Point has cut its AWS cloud bill by 58.2%. Dharmendra Raghuvanshi, Chai Point's director and head of digital transformation, shared the numbers in a LinkedIn post. Raghuvanshi says the company’s monthly AWS bill fell from $10,877 to $4,550 over 12 months. “About 80% of it came from what we call the Agentic Cost Audit,” he says.

items.title: The rise of 'agentic' in the enterprise workforce
items.summary: The rising use of AI-related terminology reflects a shift in enterprise employees' perceptions and the growing integration of AI into their daily work.

items.title: Microsoft offers exits to thousands of employees, including staff on AI and Copilot teams
items.summary: Microsoft is offering voluntary exit packages to about 60,000 employees, roughly 27% of its workforce, including staff on teams building Copilot and other AI products, as the company looks for ways to fund its AI investments. Amy Coleman, executive vice president and chief people officer, announced the Voluntary Exit Offer (VEO) in an internal memo on Monday, which Microsoft republished on its official blog . “This offer gives eligible employees who may be considering a future outside the company a new choice to make that transition now with support,” Coleman wrote in the memo. It also gives participating organizations “another way to adapt their workforce to changing needs,” she wrote in the blog.

items.title: Industrial Intelligence: The next growth opportunity for manufacturing
items.summary: Every manufacturer has its own industrial intelligence. Some is documented, and some resides in the knowledge of experienced workers. Consider an experienced operator preparing to restart a line after a changeover. The machine settings matter, but so does knowing how a particular material behaves, what happened during the previous shift, and when an apparently minor variation deserves a closer look.
